evidence.description: The documented workflow simulates a three-firm, six-period panel, residualizes the variables, and creates Figures 1 and 2.
evidence.quote:
The code first simulates balanced panel data (Y and X) using random draws from normal
distributions for three firms and six periods. It next residualizes the Y and X using a simple
regression with a constant and a firm-fixed effects regression. It finally creates Figures 1 and 2.

review_notes: The assessment covers the supplied Code.do driver. It generates the illustrative panel internally, computes the documented constant and firm-FE quantities, and exports the Figure 1 and Figure 2 panels. The datasheet describes Tables 1–3 as illustrative values with calculations in their captions; they are contextual, not separate executable stages in this package.

The author title matches the frozen title, and the supplied datasheet does not state a DOI. The working-directory local is the sole identified preparation gap; ACT-WORKING-DIR specifies the supported relative package-root setup. Stata 18 is available with the file's declared 15.1 command-interpreter behavior documented by Stata.

The source contains no external data reads and the frozen dependency checklist is empty. There is no separate analysis_only route because the same driver constructs the analysis data. No author code, regression, model, descriptive, or synthetic trial was run; execution_verified remains false.
